data.name: Billie
data.gender_notes: Billie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'William'. The name Billie is a feminized form of William, which means ‘resolute protector’ or ‘strong-willed’. In Christian tradition, Billie evokes a sense of bravery and determination. The name Billie carries the meaning “Resolute protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Billie usually hope their child will grow to embody resolute protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and strength.
data.etymology: Billie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resolute protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Billie total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: בילי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בילי מקורו בשם העברי 'ביליה', שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא השופט שלי'. השם נגזר מהשמות העבריים 'ביל' ו-'אל', שמשמעותם 'בן האל' או 'אלוהים הוא'. השם בילי משמש לעתים קרובות ככינויו של מי ששם הולדתו הוא ויליאם.

in_greek.name: Μπίλιε
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπίλιε προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'William', που σημαίνει 'α决定的 προστασία'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Μπίλιε δεν έχει άμεση αναφορά σε κάποιο πρόσωπο ή χαρακτήρα της Βίβλου ή της ιστορίας της Εκκλησίας, αλλά φέρει μια γενική χριστιανική σημασία που σχετίζεται με την προστασία και τη δύναμη που προέρχεται από το Θεό.

in_latin.name: Billie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Billie derivatur ex nomine Germanico 'Willhelm', quod significat 'voluntas protegens'. In traditione christiana, nomen Billie saepe associatur cum virtutibus fortitudinis et protectionis divinae. Etymologia nominis Billie in linguam Latinam reducitur ad origines Germanicas, quae postea fuerunt adaptatae in diversas formas linguas.

in_english.name: Billie
in_english.meaning: God is my judge or resolute protector
in_english.long_meaning: The name Billie, often a diminutive form of William, carries the meaning 'God is my judge' or 'resolute protector'. It originates from the Germanic name 'Wilhelm', composed of 'wil' (will or resolution) and 'helm' (helmet or protection). In Christian tradition, the name Billie is associated with strength, determination, and divine guidance. Historically, the name William has been borne by several saints and monarchs, adding to its significance in Christian culture.

data.cultural_impact: Billie has its roots in the Latin name William, which has historic influence and recognition as a powerful name amongst Christian communities. The name Billie gained popularity as a feminine variation of William and has been closely associated with figures such as Billie Holiday, a renowned jazz musician, and Billie Jean King, a prominent female tennis player, demonstrating the strength and resilience of women who carry this name.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Billie stems from its origins as a name of protection and strength. Historically, Christians bestowed the name William upon their sons, boys born to protect and serve as defenders for their families and communities. Billie, as a feminine form of William, retains the meaning of strong will and unwavering resolve. In spiritual terms, the name Billie signifies the strength and determination of women of faith, reminding us that no matter the challenges faced, we have the resources within ourselves to overcome obstacles and protect the things that matter most - our beliefs, our families, and our communities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Billie: God is my strength and my beauty. I trust in His providence and grace.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Billie Holiday, 1915-1959, was a legendary jazz singer. The name Billie carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: popularity in jazz music, R&B, and pop music
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Billie remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
